The public database contains 4,706 literature-derived records representing reported observations and experimental contexts. Search across record identifiers, sequences, targets, models, conditions, and source publications.

::: {.sarna-archive-callout}
**saRNA Database v1.0.0**

For the complete release package, permanent archive, and reuse citation, visit [Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.21871232](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21871232).
:::

## Search the database

The Records view shows a compact set of commonly used fields. Select **Expand** beside any row to see the complete record and its source details. The Sequences and Sources views provide the other two released data tables.

## Interpreting the records

Each row in the Records view is one reported observation or experimental record. A sequence may appear in multiple records when it was tested under different conditions, models, or publications.

Reported effects and experimental conditions are intentionally heterogeneous. Numeric values, categories, ranges, and source-specific measurements should not be treated as directly comparable without checking the underlying assay and source. Records associated with a retracted publication are retained for provenance and marked in the interface.
